proposal.title: Rukosktesh: a stub resolver with encrypted transport
proposal.summary: Rukosktesh builds a stub resolver with encrypted transport for users of public wireless networks.

sections.heading: Problem
sections.text: Many devices still send name lookups in clear text over shared networks. Users of public wireless networks depend on DNS resolution every day, yet the tools they have are hard to audit and slow to update.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build a stub resolver with encrypted transport called Rukosktesh. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: DNS resolution is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/rukosktesh/rukosktesh, which 105 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on DNS resolution for 4 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/rukosktesh/rukosktesh. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 12 months in 4 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 6. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 9. Documentation and release ends in month 12.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 68800.00 EUR for 104 days of work over 4 tasks. Day rates range from 500.00 EUR to 800.00 EUR.
